spec.outfit: an 18th-century English lady's gown of the 1770s, a robe a l'anglaise -- a wide-brimmed flat straw hat (a bergere hat) tilted slightly forward, trimmed with a pale blue silk ribbon tied in a bow; a gown of pale blue silk damask with a subtle self-coloured floral pattern: a closely fitted bodice with a low square neckline filled with a white sheer muslin kerchief (fichu) crossed over the chest, a stiff flat front panel (stomacher) trimmed with a ladder of small pale blue ribbon bows, elbow-length fitted sleeves finished with a pale blue ruched cuff and two tiers of white lace ruffles; the gown's skirt opens at the front over a cream silk petticoat; the skirt is full and rounded over the hips and falls to the ankles, hem edged with a pale blue ruched ribbon; white stockings; pale blue silk shoes with a small heel and a small silver buckle
spec.style: Photorealistic 3D character render, soft studio lighting, real fabric textures, clean period dressmaking, every garment complete and well fitted to the goose's body. The goose has NO tail.
